_comment: Copy this file to customer-config.json and fill in all values before running cdk synth.
_ec2_deploy_note: When compute_type is ec2, the synthesized template includes VpcId and SubnetIds CloudFormation parameters. The customer selects their default VPC (or any VPC) and subnets at stack deploy time — no VPC values needed here.
_lambda_deploy_note: Backend and handlers Lambda functions are not created by CloudFormation. Each repo's OIDC pipeline creates/updates its Lambda and points it at the private ECR repo after pushing the image.
